reviews.text: Roguelikes can get a bit samey, three options pop up on the screen, and the meta progression back at camp can feel like paying your bills in a terminal. But Cursemark incorporates options the old fashioned way, within the game and gameplay itself. I’ve been having fun so far unlocking all the weapons, skills, and exploring the map. As a Path of Exile 1/2 player I particularly like the skill gem and support system - it’s nice to play around with builds by choice, but also by randomness with what you find in that particular run. The art kit, overall theme, and music are also pretty good in my book. I love a man in armor. More on VGO pod tomorrow.

After only two hours of play I have thoroughly enjoyed it. I would recommend it to anyone who enjoys a casual roguelike experience with a souls-like backdrop. I did have it freeze up one time due to having too many effects on screen at one time, but that kind of stuff is to be expected in early access. All in all, solid game with a lot of promise and I can't wait for more!
偏向硬核动作，但是上手门槛不算高，对新手也挺友好的。不管是休闲玩还是深度钻研都很合适。
终于等到 EA 啦！魂系加上肉鸽的玩法结合得特别好，打击手感扎实，每一局都玩得很尽兴。
可惜steam没有中评，游戏很好玩，但手柄适配太差，尤其是地图传送和切换符文，营地篝火仍然显示添加steam愿望单

好玩，不过缺点也要吐槽下 系统方面： 1.新手教程部分可能卡门，需要自杀才能开门——小bug 2.改键后重进游戏键位回归默认，差点被坑杀——小bug 3.没有丢弃功能，天胡局乱杀，然后包满了发现不能扔垃圾…… 游戏方面： 1.特效很多，很难看到怪和boss的动作，只能靠经验记住攻击模式来判断 2.翻滚，面对霸体突进加剑圣N连，以及远程攻击，还有根本看不到地刺 的情况下，1次翻滚距离不够，无敌帧也嫌少 3.移速，带电+移速符文的情况下，面对弹幕式近远混合加地形因素，最关键还有主角体积，只能说走位作用比想象的低了很多 4.闪避，带电+闪避符文，以为100%了，结果被暴揍，看来是乘法计算…… ------ 小建议： 1.整体游戏偏向资源控制式打法，法术和翻滚什么时候交，控制怪的数量等小细节基本就是hp保障，不适合莽着打（远程精英的设计一看就是喜欢欺负莽） 2.血瓶罐头不打碎可以一直存在，打碎后不捡切换地图就会消失 核心还是别贪的游戏，感觉陷阱全在贪字上……

First off I can't believe how tiny the install size is. In the age of 100GB plus games, a game with this much content being under 200MB blows my mind. It looks great and I really like the progression system. I am not good at souls-like games and usually avoid them but I always feel like I am making some progress in this.
美术不错，整个玩下来比起传统魂系更接近幸存者，很爽的肉鸽。技能构筑深度也不错，可玩性有的。
技能构筑玩法很有意思，随着解锁的技能越来越多，游戏的可玩性也不断拓展。符文系统和技能的各类联动效果很有意思，非常喜欢，期待后续更新
本人魂游老玩家了，从demo就在关注，一路等到EA发售，体验相当不错，可以说是远超预期，玩法、手感、内容都很在线，数值很均衡。总的来说值得试一下。
比较新颖，解谜和动作和肉鸽系统都有较新的创意，雷攻击说第三下有特效但是挥不出来原因不明，内容目前来说实在太少了，4个小时左右能打完目前内容，然后打完目前内容给个提醒啊，不看公告还以为我卡关了，游戏是好玩的，希望有两点，1后续能增加大地图（不要这个图打完就结束了）。2终局要有内容，别培养完角色，也就游戏结束了。
好大的地图，地图场景也很精致，看得出来美术是下了功夫的hhh然后手感也很不错，动作游戏嘛毕竟还是。总的来说可以的。
类魂2D动作游戏和肉鸽结合，好有创意的搭配。还没完太多，但是喜欢！
玩了demo，现在比当时优化很大，手感数值还有怪的频率数量都有调整。整个玩下来体验抢了不止一点半点。玩法还是新鲜的，很有想法。感兴趣的xdm可以试试看。
很惊喜，探索关卡与关卡之间的联系还有解密体验都很不错，技能属性多样性、关卡联动解密都很优秀！期待后续正式版本
游戏的像素风格我很喜欢，画面，场景的设计都很有暗黑美感。类似于暗黑地牢的那种暗黑向像素风格。然后战斗部分，攻击打击感还不错，还允许使用一些技能去帮助攻击，而难度主要来源于怪物的数量。目前来说给我的感觉不错，大概能打到8.5/10分的评分。
看到两个开槽被塞在湖中间真的绷不住，真是畜生啊你，你放个宝箱在中间都行，放个开槽在里面
自己做的游戏自己玩吗这改那改的改了自己又不测试，几千伤害砍成以前的千分之一伤害，怪那么强怎么不见你砍，让玩的人坐牢来啦，暗影神殿跟别的boss能比吗伤害多夸张200多学满血一个冲锋给我秒了，我大半天掉5/1血全图乱跑一个失误重开了，自己改之前先测试测试，出那么多流派现在只能玩闪避流派刷不出闪避套还玩不了，没开闪避技能的怎么玩，现在改成坐牢游戏，作者脑子坏掉了

罪恶鲜血神性揉在一起仍然那么鲜美多汁。 美术不错，层次分明，战斗流畅，松弛有度，同屏敌人数量不少，有威胁性。 每轮战斗选择主法术，进图后获得随机符文，随时切换，随机应变，法术千变万化。 并且符文非常容易获得，技能利用率高，这方面的设计很出彩。 我尝试了火焰和毒素打法，毒素可以选择召唤自爆蜘蛛和毒藤墙壁。 感觉打法比较安逸 覆盖面积和视觉效果也比较爽快，毒墙有时候会把自己困住走不出来。 进游戏第一件事我极大降低了震屏百分比，有很多过场表演速度慢 拖慢了我的兴奋感。 +1，有中文，有漏翻，没成就，相信漏翻很快会修复，相信成就在正式版肯定加。

Difficult for the sake of being difficult. CMS isn't fast enough to position yourself correctly. Dodging is incredibly precise to the point of being useless. Projectiles from room 1 flood the screen without rhyme or reason. Unless you're a glutton for punishment I would not advise playing this after a long day at work.

局外的成长基本没有，每个房间的敌人奖励都是固定的，这就导致了每次发育玩家会选择固定的最优路线进行发育，更新前我可以在打完第一个房间后就去打第一个boss,来获得好的奖励，现在更新后几乎不可能，只能选择别的小房间发育，但小房间给的稀有符文的概率底，且堆怪严重。远程兵的攻击轨迹极难预测，近战兵人均霸体。往往没到boss房间就已经吃了大战损。除非你天胡开局有好符文。 再说主角性能，这个闪避跟没有一样，闪避能躲的攻击我走路的也能躲，加上boss的攻击的模式大部分是攻击距离大，长连段，比如钢铁孽种那个傻逼大风车，跑步跑不过，闪避拉不开。你的高频率攻击手段就是没有机制趋同的平A，法术，于是就只能你打你的，我打我的，没有一点交互。无法用技术水平来弥补没有凑到好构筑的问题。所有你也没有什么其他解法，就是有好的构筑然后脸滚键盘看谁先死，血量见底了就拉开回一口然后继续平A平A,法术法术。没有好构筑就打不过，打不过就开不了后面的内容，开不了后面的内容就没办法开槽位提升，打更高阶的内容，你就只能在这个轮回里面祈祷有一把能抽到好构筑来破局。如果你管这个叫魂，你吃大份去吧。 6/18 有键位失灵无反应的严重bug。

Feels very good for an early access title. The game has quite a bit of build decision, and exploring the map nodes/rooms/screens is definitely a fun time. You have some puzzles to solve and secrets to find. The longer your run lasts, the harder it gets. But it gets harder on a room by room basis, rather than time spent. Enemy variety is alright, and I can only imagine the scale the game will be at actual 1.0 launch For the price the game is, I'd definitely pick it

The basic idea looked very promising, however the actual gamefeel can be summarized as "clunky". Controlling the character feels clunky, using altar menues feels clunky. Also most runes feel like they either don't do much or don't work at all in spells and abilities where they can be slotted into. This might just be a thing of early runes being so weak you don't notice a difference though. Also I'm not sure if the idea is in fights that you just kinda have to take damage or if the idea is that you should be able to avoid all damage somehow but the controls are too clunky to actually do what you need to. At least fighting the 2 bosses I encountered I'd be surprised if you could avoid all of their attacks. There are quite a few that come out fast and have huge range or AoE and having just one dash (that doesn't seem to give i-frames) is certainly not enough. In that sense fighting bosses seems more about having a good loadout and stats prior to engagement and having found enough hp/recovery items to tank through everything, which is kinda boring tbh

The core of this game seems to be combat with skill customization. But in reality, it's just click-throughs with no tactical depth. So far, combat has proven to be the weakest part of the gameplay. It might not have been so bad if not for the critical bugs that ended 3 of my 5 runs. Two of them haven't been fixed by restarts, and I simply can't progress any further. So, a game with a couple of hours of content is very short, even for EA. Either I'm missing something, but I don't have the desire to delve deeper. I'll wait for the project to develop further. This isn't a refund, but I also can't recommend it with current state

1.暗影神殿那边的解密文本不完全说的什么玩意儿看不懂，写的完全的也有很多完全没有头绪，我他妈玩你这个我是冲着解密来的？想他妈整解密你去做解密游戏行不？ 2.探索的地图越多怪物越强可以理解，但是你得有个限度吧，我300的血，被一个尖刺擦一下直接秒了是何数值？ 3.个别小怪伤害高的一批，西边放地刺的跟东边放弹幕的两个怪真是擦着伤碰着死，完事攻击又远又快又难躲 4.符文能融合但护符不能 5.死亡之后身上道具返回的资源过少，购买铁匠的功能从第九次开始就直接离谱开了 6.希望每一局结束后可以保留一个或几个道具留在下一局使用 ----------------------------------2026.7.19 手柄还是有和护符升级台无法呼出界面的BUG，点一下自动关闭，这个问题在我第一次玩的时候就有，那个时候我就会用键盘互动，就可以正常呼出界面，现在练键盘也无法呼出该界面了，以至于我都无法正常的完成一局游戏，简直你妈的垃圾游戏，汉化还不完全，营地中刷新呼符之前1个素材刷一次，现在也变成递增了，你改你麻痹呢跟你妈个脑残一样我操你妈滚出我的电脑

1. 有些解密的线索提示根本不知道在哪找，建议把提示解密线索的石头标注在地图上。 2. 暗影神殿怪物强度明显比沼泽高一大截。在一个以近战为主要输出手段的游戏中，暗影神殿区域成功的研发了两种猛猛发弹幕的小怪。如果开发团队没有打算内置一款东方小游戏的话，我的建议是赶紧削弱。 3. 属性值的叠加计算方式不明确。例如现在有个+15%闪避的遗物，那么在你开启了+50%闪避率的雷电守护神技后，属性面板上面的闪避率只有54.8%。我到体验完EA内容为止都不知道这个54.8%是怎么计算出来的，既不是乘加，也不是叠加，如果有人知道的话请告诉我。 4. 一些装备的文本翻译问题，点名批评那个加最大生命值的金色兽皮，描述写的是：让你的最大生命值倍增。到手一看，1级+15%。甚至不如路边10块钱+20最大生命值的生命水井。 5. 没办法洗技能点，同时技能没有演示。解锁后才能知道这个技能的释放方式。并且目前这个版本好像还缺5个技能点才能点满全技能。 6. 局外成长太少了，只能通过在营地买遗物增加人物强度，哪怕增加一个购买初始符文的NPC呢。 7. 从营地里出来到第一张图并不会刷新你的技能充能，在营地里切换技能也不会。这意味着如果你想测试不同的终结技，那么你要不断去砍右下角的骷髅。 8. 战斗UI问题，法术和终结技的充能太不显眼了，特别是终结技的充能进度仅有一个非常小的百分比文本。在高强度的战斗时根本很难注意到法术或者终结技充能完毕。
One of if not the best fighting games you will play this year (2026).

amazing game. if you liked hades you'll have a great time with this one. it has a power system similar to path of exile, you choose 4 skills and then slot gems in them that have multiple effects, like bigger aoe, explode on death or more projectiles. doesnt feel like an EA game

Good things. - Art is very good. - The overall gameplay: exploration, metaprogression, upgrades within a run - all seems well thought out. Bad things. - Combat is a mess with barely visible enemies, attack spam, and projectile spam. - All my best runs were relying on same item (barier on spell cast). Sure, there are other winning builds, but repeating the same run until you get a winning combination of items gets boring.

这游戏当初试玩版给我一种未来可期的俯视角类魂的感觉，但有符文护符等系统以为能爽起来，所以发售后也是买了找时间玩，毕竟当心爆雷等了几天一看好评挺多的，就买来玩。一开始还觉得有来有回，也就城门附近区域的法师卫兵有点不似人，读指令丟火球就强迫玩家在它发射攻击后必须朝反方向位移而且越近越容易击中你，当时已经感觉不对劲但还是觉得可能是想给玩家上难度，我忍了，到沼泽区直接绷不住了，狭窄地形，堆远程敌人：释放一排伤害判定的地刺的怪；连发5发针刺、射完漏没一秒破绽就缩地无敌的炮塔怪，关键是这家伙冒头就射，射完就缩地无敌，还放好几只互相接应；超雄连射迫击炮怪，射程一个屏幕，玩家闪避cd无护符影响的情况下大概2秒还是3秒闪一次，这个比亚迪连射好几发你闪避动作结束还得吃外加这游戏读指令你就别想什么走位躲了旁边还有其他近战怪追着复读咿呀剑法一样冲锋围殴你。其次，别的游戏都是鼓励玩家多探多得，越打资源越丰富越强，这游戏你清理房间越多，怪物属性越强，等于强迫你规划路线重复玩，禁止你一个bd杀穿全局，打完boss你解除封印就会结束当局游戏（好像是9个封印，对应9个大boss） 所以这游戏玩法师什么呢？探图，投资，走线，探过的图和解锁过的捷径不会消失，你要规划好每次去每个区域路上的护符升级、护符升级和融合设施，利用星空泪升级增加使用次数，每次减少清房次数和增加使用更多设施和收集bd的机会去打封印boss，我花了几小时吃瘪后，把这游戏看成数值rpg后看开了，选暗属性带吸血的普攻，配合神圣惩击符文（减怪攻击和攻速），叠攻速和攻击次数（护符红爪子和连击符文），叠护甲（护甲类护符、祝福），利用施法加护盾的魔剑士盾护符（释放技能给护盾，等于额外hp但有上限），直接当蛆一样黏着boss和敌人打，甚至boss比小怪还弱，因为小怪还能分散打你，boss贴着按住左键差不多了，因为还有吸血，所以其他bd感觉都是浮云，改了这个bd直接拿下两个封印boss。 这游戏就是个畸形儿，像是一开始想走俯视角类魂，又把图内设施作为局外成长，真正意义上的局外成长只有解锁那几个寥寥无几的垃圾技能和普攻，与及开局花点星泪roll和花钱买个初始饰品、铁匠弄几次额外强化。然后沼泽那疑似脑子一抽给怪的行动模式上猛药，让人确认了这根本不是尼莫的类魂，就是特马的rpg，你前面一血不掉清一个房间，那边直接给你下猛药，让你以类魂思维去打，一个房间打掉你一两瓶血，直接把你道上打死，配合我们不死人喜欢舔地板的性格，去了那边直接20+罪印等级，敌人全是精英怪，华山论剑就是这样论剑玩家的。 退不了款的我只能说能不买就不买，看不到改好的可能，即使改了，因为这个投资设施增加使用次数，下一局也能用的机制，就导致地图固定，反复玩真没啥意思，这罪业等级也导致你探图越多怪越强，你的提升是有限的，所以不建议买。

A real hidden gem of a game. One of the best roguelites out there. Seems very hard at first, but gets easier with metaprogression. Combat is somewhat similar to Hades, but power comes from figuring out build synergies more than from player skill. There is a nice twist where enemies gets stronger when you clear each node on the map, so you can't go on forever - you can only clear so many nodes before you die. So you have to set your goals and carefully plan your route on the map. The dark fantasy world is well executed. Evokes Blood Omen: Legacy of Kain vibes for me. Exploration is fun and rewarding, with lots of secrets to uncover. I'm having a great time with it so far.

当前版本冰武器强势，范围大伤害高攻速适中，两刀能回一个豆，主打技能输出就行，道中有回声就无脑拿，连锁xx+1符文可以触发射烬一类的弹幕符文，沼泽的小怪太NM超雄了，刺球还有迫击炮过于逆天了，希望伤害能调低一些，boss战设计拉完了，明显是冲着不想让你交互去的，暗影之器来回瞬移冲锋地图一堆弹幕这是给人打的？还有boss的击退抗性太低了，圣锤戒指+急速戒指打boss跟踢皮球一样，希望之后的版本可以移除圣锤戒指的强击退效果，毒武器的攻速过于慢了，而且要A4刀才能回一个豆，属于是屁用没有，最好调成两刀，有部分符文效果太拉了，而且有符文熔炉什么时候来个护符熔炉，地图探索越打自己越脆，希望在之后的版本打完地区boss不要结算而是清零罪业值接着探索，这样玩起来更是爽的没边，目前的版本局外成长有些太弱了，营地最好能多加一些NPC，游戏优缺点都不少，希望游戏越来越好吧(๑•̀ㅂ•́)و✧

if i could give it a mix score i would. but sadly i have to give it a thumb down. first and formost: for such a small price you still get enough content for your bucks. but why i gave it a thumb down? because this game totally not what it want you to believe it is. its not a roguelike\lite per se. noh its soulslike. noh its a hades clone. like many said in reviews. hades like 100 times more complicated. And this game has no randomized map, random enemies. It's the same map and same mobs all the time. changes only drop (so already after like 5th run you gonna be trapped in groundhog day). so what is it? closest i can describe - its a metroidvaine. especially you gonna get this feeling if played blasphemous. also game have vibes of deadcells (minus its huge variativity). and here why i gave it a thumb down. because it wasnt obvious... noh in description of game, noh in trailer. and worst part - its not even a good metroidvaine. its pretty simplistic metroidvaine. more like a mobile title. and combat very boring. while we have a lot of skills (ultimtes, spells, etc) they all mostly the same and change almost nothing in gameplay. and worst part that when you have a lot of skills upgraded and so much happening on screen you just cant see the main mechanic of the game - enemies coming attack icon (and visual setting not helping to change it). and this game becaming just one button mash very fast (with dodge mechanic in between). also game has some huge aiming problems. either you play with aimassist or without it. prepare for your range skills change direction in last second. silver lining: i was waiting this game for very long time. and im totally dissapointed in which way dev decided to go with this product. it showed so much potential to be a very smart soulslike-roguelite. but became more a mobile game with very few real mechanics. but again - for such a price you still get some fun from it. but not me. for me it just made me want to replay blaphemous 1 and 2.

Very unique rougelite. Exploration, secrets, etc. that I haven't seen in another games. Map is static, only the item drops are random. There are a bunch of really novel ideas on how your skills upgrade throughout a run. You can even alter your skill alterations by combining two socketables, really enjoyed discovering new combinations through different runs. This enemy design is one of my favorite things about the game, there are no "meat sack enemies that do nothing and die in 1 hit" that are so common in ARPG games. There are a ton of different enemy types, and each one of them is distinct with recognizable attack patterns. Each type of enemy can span as an 'elite' with upgraded attack patterns that are still true to the flavor of the monster type. ------ ** This review was left during early access, so who knows what could change, but here are some small gripes. For the RNG, a run can feel doomed if you start with bad items. When you die early it effects your next run as you'll have drastically less starting resources. I feel like I occasionally have to do "intend to die, spend nothing" runs to get my resources back up for a decent go at a later attempt. Wish there was a bit more *character based* permanent progression. You have to hit big milestones for pretty mediocre buffs. Most of the progression is investing in certain map nodes, but that only helps you if you are going in that direction. Would love to see more "invest substantial resources to permanently upgrade yourself" stuff in town. Some regular enemies are harder than bosses. (Looking at you, rolling spike bramble). You can easily get decimated by a random elite & then faceroll a boss on the next screen. ------ I'll reiterate that these are *SMALL* gripes, and the game is still very worth playing. I will absolutely be hopping back into this word periodically to see how the game progresses.

This game has a very interesting premise, and on top of that, it features some absolutely beautiful pixel art. The art direction is easily one of the game's strongest points. Every environment, enemy, and effect has a lot of personality, and the overall aesthetic gives the game a unique charm that kept me engaged from the very beginning. When you first start playing, it's very easy to feel overwhelmed by the sheer number of shrines, unlockables, and different things available from the very beginning. Fortunately, the game does a good job of guiding you toward what you should focus on, so the progression feels natural and rewarding rather than frustrating. As you continue playing, each run feels worthwhile because you are constantly unlocking something new or making meaningful progress. One of the aspects I enjoyed the most was the build variety. There are many different ways to approach the game, and experimenting with different combinations is genuinely fun. I especially liked the decision to randomize the runes in every new playthrough, since it forces you to adapt and prevents every run from feeling exactly the same. Finding a strong combination and slowly realizing that your build is starting to come together is always satisfying. Another thing that kept me constantly engaged was the amount of secrets hidden throughout the game. I always appreciate when developers reward curiosity, and Cursemark does a good job in that regard. Discovering hidden areas and unexpected rewards gave me a reason to keep exploring and pushed me to play "just one more run" several times. That being said, the game definitely has some weak points. The biggest issue for me is the dash mechanic. It feels a bit too slow for the type of attacks the game throws at you, and there were many situations where it felt like I was going to get hit no matter what I did. Movement in general could use a bit more polish to make combat feel smoother. Balance is another area that could be improved. As many players have already pointed out, it's currently very easy to completely break the game if you find certain overpowered combinations. While discovering broken builds can be fun at first, it also makes some runs considerably easier than they probably should be. Even with those issues, I think Cursemark has a lot of potential. With a few updates, some balance adjustments, and additional content, this could become a very interesting game in the future. The foundation is already there, and the developers clearly have good ideas. For now, my plan is to keep playing until I finally beat it and continue experimenting with new builds while waiting for future updates. At the end of the day, the game succeeds at the most important thing: it's fun. Sometimes that's all a game needs to be. Final Score: 65/100 [██████░░░░]

Wildly unbalanced. It is way too early for this game to be out, even for early access. I can forgive the clunky UI and animations, but the core gameplay loop is too tedious and exhausting. The enemies are balanced around you already having broken synergies and combos. -The melee enemies have long attack strings and lock on to you the entire time. This is made worse by the fact that dodge is on a cooldown. -The ranged enemies have crazy far aggro distance and range. Some will even carpet bomb you from outside of view distance. Did I mention that they also lock on to you the entire time as well? -As if these weren't enough, the enemies also get stronger and beefier over time, demanding perfect play. There is no way to avoid this as the pathing forces you to take suboptimal routes. If you have the broken synergies, great! But what about the other 90% of the time you don't? Just not fun. Equipment system feels like an afterthought. Most of the runes are useless. Even the 'good' ones don't necessarily help much, even after upgrading. Some don't even improve or are worse after upgrading! Same for the talismans. The upgrades don't feel worth it at all. I felt the game was more like a chore than a game. Coming from the dev's previous game, I was excited to see what they were cooking. But this honestly feels like a step back. Skip for now.

TLDR: Great game, I recommend fully if you like the style and have the skills/patience. Too hard for me personally. Game is great, I just suck at reactionary timing and hard skill checks. I like the design and concept of the game a lot, but the punishment of failing and restarting so often was too much for me, getting a fun build going and then having it ripped away from you for one mistake just really sucked for me. I recognize the potential for fun if I had the skills/patience for this game, but I am in my late 30s, at this point I can figure out if a game is gonna be too much for me pretty quick, losing your souls to upgrade yourself is one thing, losing most of your build and keeping little upgrades, that's levels of punishing I don't have the patience for. However, I might like this, if I was young and needed a more difficult challenge than typical roguelike ARPGs. It really does feel like a solid blend of Dark Souls/Diablo 2 though, as it suggests, it's just a bit too punishing for me personally. Fully recommend it though for what it is, especially if challenge is a big selling point for you with games.
